source.authority: Primary experimental Methods and author-released condition fields, with the original strain-construction table
source.reference: Elizondo BR and Saa PA (2025), ACS Synthetic Biology 14(9), DOI 10.1021/acssynbio.5c00256, PMC12455641, Methods 2.1.1-2.1.2 and 2.1.4; author repository SysBioengLab/BcarGRASP; constructs verified in Lopez et al. (2020), DOI 10.3389/fbioe.2020.578793, Table 1.

condition.native_context_assumption: Transfer from frozen native DS28911/W303 glucose/O2 exchange curves and native glycerol commitments to a CEN.PK2-1c-derived strain in supplemented YNB. Cross-strain and medium equivalence is an explicit, unvalidated extrapolation; no product measurements or target-study exchange rates adjust these priors.

experiments.condition_source_ref: source_index.json#/condition_id_mapping/0; PMC12455641 Methods 2.1.1-2.1.2; BcarGRASP DilutionRatesStatistics.xlsx, Statistics!A2:C2. Zero denotes no extra NaCl intervention in the enumerated cultivation recipe, not zero basal sodium or osmolality; see source_index.json#/protocol_evidence/added_nacl.

strain_and_construct.construct_evidence: PMC7556307 Table 1, beta-Car2.1 row; PMC12455641 Methods 2.1.1 explicitly maps beta-car2 to beta-Car2.1. ASCII beta and Delta replace the corresponding Greek characters; TCYC is the construction table's notation.
strain_and_construct.product_context: Beta-carotene-pathway strain with intracellular lycopene measured as an intermediate, not a lycopene-only terminal producer. Gene copies describe construction, not fitted expression or flux capacity.
